title: 第26章 老疯子第27章 抢婚
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“哈哈，新娘子果然漂亮啊，身材真的好啊，真的棒棒哒！”
“是啊，王少爷艳福不浅啊，找了这么漂亮的极品尤物，天天晚上都能爽了，真的羡慕死了。”
……
如今在看到了婀娜多姿的林仙儿后，听到王杰少爷的话后，诸多武者宾客都笑嘻嘻的打趣起来。
其中一些猥琐的武者男性，更是色眯眯的用目光打量着林仙儿那丰满的身体，那婚纱下丰腴丝袜大腿，他们的目光里满是淫邪，有的人甚至都有了生理反应。
毕竟这些武者大都是未婚男性，自然也是喜欢美女，尤其是林仙儿这种顶级美女，看到如此尤物他们自然受不了。
当然，他们也只能看看而已，是不敢没有想法的，毕竟林仙儿是王少的女人，王少怎么也是古武家族的大少爷，他们还是要给点面子的，毕竟金陵王家可不是好惹的。
“哈哈！”
而看到这么多人用淫荡的目光看着自己的老婆，王杰不生气反而很是得意，毕竟他的老婆再漂亮也只能他享受，别人也只能过过眼瘾罢了。
他拿着酒杯开始给一些宾客敬酒了。
当然，光他自己敬酒不成，林仙儿也是一样的，王杰还让林仙儿给客人敬酒，女人要懂得规矩和礼数。
林仙儿无奈的用手在桌子上拿起一个装满葡萄酒的玻璃酒杯，打算给客人敬酒，不过就在此刻意外发生了，也不知道从哪里冒出来一个老头，老头脏兮兮的和乞丐一样，脸上身上都是泥巴。
他直接走到了王杰的面前，用手指着他大喊起来：“王少爷，你还我女儿命来。”
说完，就直接跪在地上用手抱住了王杰的双腿，导致王杰手中的酒水洒了一身。
这一下突如其来的情况让在场的人都惊呆了，每个人都目光惊讶的看着王杰，而王杰也是惊呆了。
他仔细看着抱着自己的腿的老乞丐，对方脸上都是泥巴看不清楚长相，不过王杰却认为自己不认识对方。
“大家听好了，王杰少爷是一个玩弄女人的人渣，我的女儿才18岁就被王少爷玩了，肚子都被搞大了。结果王少爷玩了我女儿后不要我女儿了，我女儿昨天晚上气不过投河自杀了，呜呜，可怜我一个老头子老年丧女啊，痛彻心扉啊。”
老乞丐跪在了地上大哭起来，哭的是泪流满面。
听到老乞丐的话，在场的宾客再次惊呆，都怔怔的看着王杰少爷。
而林仙儿也是惊呆了，她也看着王杰，虽然林仙儿不喜欢王杰，不过今天她到底是和王杰大婚的日子，在这场婚礼过后王杰也算是她丈夫了。

但是现在王杰竟然搞出这种事情，她也感觉很是无语很悲哀。
“王杰啊王杰，我知道你风流，就算你背着我玩女人我也不会说什么，但是你怎么搞出人命了。还让人家的父亲找上门来了啊，你真是烂泥扶不墙了。”
林仙儿心里默默说道，本来她都看不起王杰，觉得王杰没有父母屁都不是。如果王杰不是出生在王家他只有在工厂打螺丝的命，王杰能有今天完全是运气好投胎好。
而现在出了这种事情，她对王杰更加失望了。
“仙儿不别相信他，这老疯子胡说八道，我什么时候欺负过他女儿。”
看到林仙儿嫌弃的眼神，王杰则气得疯掉了。虽然王杰很风流，不过那些被他玩的女人基本上都是拜金女，比如酒吧夜场的女人，那些女的也是和他玩玩而已，毕竟可以从他身上捞到钱，双方压根没任何爱情。
content_en:
"Haha, the bride is really beautiful, her figure is really good, she looks great!"
"Yes, Master Wang is so blessed. He has found such a beautiful and top-notch beauty. He can enjoy himself every night. I am so envious."
…
Now after seeing the graceful Lin Xian'er and hearing what Master Wang Jie said, many of the warrior guests started laughing and joking.
Some of the wretched male warriors looked at Lin Xianer's plump body and plump stocking thighs under the wedding dress with squinting eyes. Their eyes were full of lust, and some of them even had physiological reactions.
After all, most of these warriors are unmarried men, and they naturally like beauties, especially top beauties like Lin Xianer. Naturally they can't stand seeing such a beauty.
Of course, they could only take a look and didn't dare to have any ideas. After all, Lin Xian'er was Young Master Wang's woman, and Young Master Wang was also the eldest young master of the Guwu family. They still had to give her some face. After all, the Jinling Wang family was not someone to be trifled with.
"Haha!"
Seeing so many people looking at his wife with lustful eyes, Wang Jie was not angry but very proud. After all, no matter how beautiful his wife was, he could only enjoy it, and others could only enjoy it.
He took a wine glass and began to toast some guests.
Of course, he alone could not toast, and the same was true for Lin Xianer. Wang Jie also asked Lin Xianer to toast the guests. Women must know the rules and etiquette.
Lin Xianer helplessly picked up a glass filled with wine on the table and planned to toast the guests. But at this moment, an accident happened. An old man appeared out of nowhere. The old man was as dirty as a beggar, with mud on his face and body.
He walked directly in front of Wang Jie, pointed at him and shouted: "Master Wang, give back my daughter's life."
After saying that, he knelt on the ground and hugged Wang Jie's legs with his hands, causing the drink in Wang Jie's hand to spill all over.
This sudden situation shocked everyone present. Everyone looked at Wang Jie in surprise, and Wang Jie was also stunned.
He looked carefully at the old beggar holding his legs. His face was covered with mud and he could not see his appearance clearly, but Wang Jie thought he did not recognize him.
"Everyone, listen up, Master Wang Jie is a scumbag who plays with women. My daughter was played by Master Wang when she was only 18 years old, and her belly was so big. As a result, Master Wang did not want my daughter after he played with my daughter. My daughter was so angry that she committed suicide by throwing herself into the river last night. Wow, pity me, an old man who lost his daughter in old age, it hurts my heart."
The old beggar knelt on the ground and cried loudly, with tears streaming down his face.
Hearing the old beggar's words, the guests present were shocked again and looked at Master Wang Jie in confusion.
Lin Xianer was also shocked. She also looked at Wang Jie. Although Lin Xianer didn't like Wang Jie, today was the day of her wedding to Wang Jie. After this wedding, Wang Jie could be regarded as her husband.
But now that Wang Jie had done something like this, she felt very speechless and sad.
"Wang Jie, Wang Jie, I know you're a flirt. Even if you were playing with women behind my back, I wouldn't say anything. But how could you kill someone? And let my father come to your door? You really can't hold up the wall."
Lin Xianer said silently in her heart that she originally looked down on Wang Jie and felt that Wang Jie was nothing without his parents. If Wang Jie had not been born into the Wang family, he would have had no choice but to work as a screwdriver in a factory. Wang Jie would be where he is today simply because he was lucky enough to be reincarnated.
But now that something like this happened, she was even more disappointed in Wang Jie.
"Xian'er, don't believe him. This old lunatic is talking nonsense. When did I ever bully his daughter?"
Seeing Lin Xianer's disgusted look, Wang Jie was so angry that he went crazy. Although Wang Jie is very romantic, the women he plays with are basically money-worshiping women, such as women in bars and nightclubs. Those women also play with him.That's all, after all, you can make money from him, there is no love between the two parties at all.
